def blockpos():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    os = [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='O']

path = ['UP','RIGHT','UP','UP','UP','UP','UP','RIGHT','RIGHT','DOWN','RIGHT','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','UP','UP','UP','UP','UP','UP','UP','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','DOWN','DOWN','LEFT','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN']
ok = True
for i, s in enumerate(path):
    before = blockpos()
    res = action([s])
    after = blockpos()
    done = res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete')
    moved = before != after
    print(i, s, before, "->", after, "moved:", moved, "done:", done)
    if done:
        print("DONE at", i, res.get('stop_reason'))
        break
    if not moved:
        print("BLOCKED at", i, s)
        ok = False
        break
print("final:", blockpos())
</parameter>
</function>
